description:
A hospital social worker needs to document transportation expenses for a patient. Navigate to the patient 'Maria Santos' in HospitalRun, go to her Social Work section, and add a new expense entry with the following details:

- Category: Transportation
- Amount/Cost: 45.00
- Description: Round-trip taxi fare for chemotherapy appointment at oncology clinic

The expense should be saved to Maria Santos's patient record under the Social Work expenses section.

HospitalRun is running at http://localhost:3000 and you are logged in as hradmin (password: test).
